\begin{proposition}\label{prop:ftildemins}$(\theta_\star,\phi_\star)$ maximize $\tilde{\ell}(\theta,\phi):=M^{-1}\sum_{m=1}^M\log \tilde{p}_{\theta,\phi}(x^m)$ iff $(\theta_\star,\phi_\star,q^{1:M}_\star)$ minimize $\tilde{F}$ for some $q_\star^{1:M}$, where $\tilde{p}_{\theta,\phi}(x^m) := \int \tilde{p}_{\theta,\phi}(x^m,z_{0:K}) \dd z_{0:K}$ for all $m \in [M]$.
\end{proposition}

new_relative_to_source.meaning: Exact Gaussian integration of the source mini-batch one-step scalar quadratic moment; not an assumed moment recurrence.
Closed-form all-iteration moment recursion and fixed second moment for the exact scalar source update. A fixed moment is not asserted to be a full invariant law.
Exact conditional Gaussian moments and moment fixed points for full-noise inverse-inclusion updates and selected drift-plus-noise random scan.
An actual Dirac finite-second-moment initial law cannot have a time-zero density relative to a measure with null singleton; disproves literal universal A2 on nonatomic Euclidean latent space.
Constructs \(F(X)\) in actual \(L^2\), realizes force and Euler iterates a.e., derives \(L^2\) regularity from pointwise regularity; no assumed abstract random-force regularity.
Orthogonal heterogeneous Hilbert variables have exact average squared norm \(K^{-2}\sum_i\|X_i\|^2\) and bound \(V/K\); applies to genuine \(L^2\) zero cross moments.

Actual finite-discrete-probability expectation gives exact finite-population correction from primitive first/pair inclusion probabilities and cardinality. Uniform-subset combinatorics is an explicit interface, not claimed constructed.
Explicit finite-cloud, discretization and oracle error bound for the actual lifted pointwise Euler recursion, with application hypotheses retained.
Division-free particle/step-size criteria and logarithmic burn-in for a five-way accuracy budget.
One-sided evidence approximation error \(\delta\) and optimization tolerance \(\varepsilon\) give parameter error \(\sqrt{2(\delta+\varepsilon)/\rho}\).

source_issues: Universal time-zero smoothness incompatible with arbitrary \(\mathcal P_2\) initial laws.
Zero penalty at a tilted optimizer does not imply untilted likelihood optimality.
Main Algorithm 1 noises all particles at temperature \(B/M\) but uses unbiased full-rate drift.
Adaptive algorithm tracks positive loss gradient but displays an ascent particle update.
State-dependent preconditioning, annealing, reweighting and extra noise scaling are not covered by the full-batch theorem.
Supplement temporal bound contains an extra square-root factor.
Supplement Gaussian backward conditional and KL formulas have variance inconsistencies.
Uniform random-time diffusion estimator omits \(K\) on the selected summand of a summed objective.
unclaimed: Independent reconstruction of every continuum optimal transport, entropy and SDE theorem from the four raw source assumptions.
Full invariant-law result for the nonlinear adaptive Adam scheme.
Global literature novelty for content labelled new relative to the supplied source.

unproved_application_obligations: Construction of a frozen posterior reference with fixed target parameter and uniform moments
Residual representation and zero cross moments for the intended posterior cloud
Trajectory-specific oracle cross-moment cancellation (not yet derived from a filtration-based conditional sampling construction)

new_accuracy_budget.scope_note: Five \(\varepsilon/5\) allocations and logarithmic burn-in. Computational complexity requires constants bounded independently of \(K\) and \(h\).

new_one_sided_model_bias.scope_note: Original evidence strongly concave; \(0\le\ell-\widetilde\ell\le\delta\) uniformly; \(\varepsilon\)-approximate tilted optimizer gives error at most \(\sqrt{2(\delta+\varepsilon)/\rho}\).

completion_statement: This audit does not certify the literal printed source statements from the four raw displayed assumptions. All 19 corrected source statements are proved under the explicit extra assumptions R1–R7. The normalized variational theorem and actual log-density integral identity are proved on their explicit normalization/integrability domains; the finite-dimensional optimizer is proved from joint convexity. Continuous parameter and product-state decay is proved for every classical solution in the R1–R4 class from its equations, dominated differentiation, integration by parts and regular transport; existence of such a classical density solution is not constructed. Several literal source claims are refuted or corrected. New actual-coordinate, \(L^2\), stochastic-numerical, accuracy-budget, model-bias and oracle-variance results are proved under their complete hypotheses.
